units.source_text: 且说藤壶皇后的哥哥兵部卿亲王费尽心计教养女儿，

en.t: Now Prince Hyobukyo, the elder brother of Empress Fujitsubo, devoted every effort to raising his daughter,
earnestly hoping that she would enter the palace as soon as possible.

units.source_text: 但因源氏内大臣与他有隙，迄未如愿。

en.t: But because there was a rift between him and Genji, the Minister of the Interior, his wish had not yet been fulfilled.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后设法调解，煞费苦心。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo tried to mediate between them and went to great pains over it.

units.source_text: 权中纳言的女儿现已成为弘徽殿女御，她的祖父太政大臣把她当作女儿一般爱护。

en.t: The daughter of the Provisional Middle Counselor had now become the Kokiden consort, and her grandfather, the Grand Minister, cherished her as though she were his own daughter.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝也把这女御当作最亲昵的游伴。

en.t: Emperor Reizei also treated this consort as his closest playmate.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后想道：“兵部卿亲王的女儿与冷泉帝年龄相仿佛，

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo thought, "Prince Hyobukyo's daughter is about the same age as Emperor Reizei,

units.source_text: 将来即使入宫，也不过是多了个弄玩偶的游伴而已。

en.t: so even if she enters the palace in the future, she will merely add another companion for playing with dolls.

units.source_text: 能有一个年纪稍长的人来照管宫闱，真乃可喜之事。”

en.t: It would truly be welcome to have someone a little older to look after the inner palace."

units.source_text: 她这么想，就把此意告知冷泉帝。

en.t: Thinking this, she conveyed her view to Emperor Reizei.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣对冷泉帝关怀无微不至：辅相朝廷政治，自不必说，连冷泉帝朝夕起居种种细事，也都用心照顾。

en.t: Genji, the Minister of the Interior, cared for Emperor Reizei with the utmost attentiveness: not only did he assist with court politics, but he also carefully looked after every small detail of the emperor's daily life, morning and evening.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后睹此情状，甚是放心。

en.t: Seeing this, Empress Fujitsubo felt very much at ease.

units.source_text: 她近来体弱多病，即使入宫，亦难于安心照料皇上。

en.t: Recently she had been frail and often ill, so even if she came to the palace, it would be difficult for her to care for the emperor with peace of mind.

units.source_text: 故物色一年纪稍长的女御随侍御侧，确是必不可少之事。

en.t: Therefore, finding a somewhat older consort to attend at the emperor's side was indeed indispensable.
